subject: Renewal: Q4 capacity uplift & temporary price hold
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabrand.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — usage spike and pricing flexibility

Diego,

Thanks for the check-in. We're running ahead of the original forecast — Q3 usage was ~2.6x what we modeled. We're preparing a renewal conversation for the end of Q3 and need to align on three things quickly: (1) short-term price stability while we finalize a bigger commit, (2) a credits/offset mechanism for the ramp months, and (3) an accelerated onboarding plan for two new product lines.

High level ask from procurement: a 90-day temporary price hold at current effective rate, plus an initial pool of usage credits to cover the ramp months (Sept–Nov). We are open to a commit-based structure after that (ideally a 12–18 month term). Can Redwood propose a bridge that keeps our unit economics intact while we firm up volume?

I'll loop in procurement/legal once we have a proposal.

Best,
Samir
VP Product, NovaBrand

--
Samir Khan | samir.k@novabrand.com | +1 415-555-0147

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabrand.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — usage spike and pricing flexibility

Samir — really glad you flagged this and congrats on the product momentum. We can do a short-term bridge. Proposed approach: 

• 90-day temporary price hold at your current effective blended rate (Sept 30–Dec 1).
• One-time ramp credit pool equal to 15% of expected monthly spend for Oct and Nov (applied as dollar credits on invoices).
• Commit pathway: convert to a 12-month volume commit by Dec 1 with a tiered uplift schedule (month-by-month commitments that ramp into a firm baseline). If you sign the commit by Dec 1 we can offer an additional 8% credit against the first quarter of the commit.

I've attached a draft term sheet (redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf) and a usage snapshot request (usage-snapshot-q3.csv) — can you share the PO/procurement timeline? If procurement needs DocuSign, we can send a configured agreement link.

Next steps: if this aligns, I’ll run a brief internal approval with Marissa (pricing) and Ben (finance) and send a mutual action plan and DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Diego
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

--
Diego Fernandez | diego.fernandez@redwood.com | (650) 555-2190

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal bridge — internal pricing options

Diego / Ben — quick internal note on approvals and guardrails:

Thanks for the context. Finance is comfortable with a temporary price hold if we include one of the following as a binding commitment by Dec 1: 

Option A (preferred): 12-month commit with a 10% blended discount over current list + the 15% ramp credit pool. Offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of Q1 forecast.

Option B (bridge-first): 90-day price hold + 15% ramp credit pool, followed by a 12-month commit within 60 days of the hold ending. In this case approve a smaller incentive: 6% discount on the first quarter of the commit and no onboarding credit.

We should avoid open-ended credits — make credits timeboxed and tied to a mutual action plan. I've updated redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf with the Option labels and included redlines. Sending back to you for Diego to share with the customer as a clean summary.

Marissa
Head of Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf (term summary, discount table, commitment triggers)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabrand.com>, Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@novabrand.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — mutual action plan and DocuSign

Samir / Lisa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on internal alignment we recommend Option B to give you runway while NovaBrand finalizes product line forecasts. Summary (high level):

1) 90-day temporary price hold at current effective rate: Sept 30–Dec 1, 2026.
2) Ramp credit pool: one-time credit equal to 15% of combined Oct+Nov forecast (applies as invoice credit through Dec).
3) Commit conversion window: sign a 12-month volume commit no later than Feb 1, 2027. If signed by Dec 1, an extra 8% initial-quarter credit applies.
4) Onboarding acceleration: we will prioritize two product lines for Q4 onboarding — dedicated onboarding slot and playbook (no charge beyond credits above).

Attached: redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf (clean copy), usage-snapshot-q3.csv (what we need to calculate credit dollar amount). DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/sign/abcd-1234 — this is populated for the Option B path.

Action items for NovaBrand: Please review the term sheet, return the signed DocuSign (or confirm PO) by Oct 10 to lock the Dec 1 credit uplift. Procurement contact: procurement@novabrand.com. 

If procurement needs a PO first, attach your PO template and we’ll match invoice flow.

Best,
Diego
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood-term-sheet-v3.pdf, usage-snapshot-q3.csv

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@novabrand.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novabrand.com, Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@novabrand.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — mutual action plan and DocuSign

Diego / Marissa — appreciate the clarity. Procurement is asking for two things before they circulate for signatures: (a) a slightly expanded billing bridge that explicitly states credit application order (apply ramp credit before any monthly overage calculations), and (b) a short appendix that captures the onboarding SLA and estimated completion dates for the two product lines. I've attached our PO template (novabrand-po-template.docx).

We are comfortable with Option B provided Finance signs off on the expected ROI by Oct 12 and contractions/legal sign the DocuSign by Oct 15. I'll push procurement to get PO back by Oct 8. Please route the DocuSign to procurement@novabrand.com and cc legal@novabrand.com.

On the DocuSign link you sent I see Item 4 (commit conversion window) — can you add the explicit clause that ramp credits are exhausted prior to any tier adjustments? That will keep our month-by-month forecast predictable.

If you send an updated clean term sheet with the two clarifications, procurement will attach their PO and we can proceed.

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product, NovaBrand
